archetype: Dark Organic & Earthy (Deep Forest & Ruined Stone)

typography.instructions: Import Cormorant Garamond and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.

layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12 for content sections.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Use Bento grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8) for Locations and Characters.

surfaces.cards: Solid stone (#151B17) background, 1px rust border (#2C362F), no soft shadows by default.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards subtly glow on hover: border shifts to rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.5), slight -translate-y-1, box-shadow shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(251,191,36,0.1)].

buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#FBBF24] text-[#FBBF24] hover:bg-[#FBBF24]/10 transition-colors

components.cards: Remove Shadcn default soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders and flat backgrounds.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards against dark backgrounds. Never use pure black/white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').

hero_background.description: Ancient mossy ruins. Must have a dark gradient overlay (bg-black/50 or darker) so title text is readable.

lantern_motif.description: Glowing lantern. Good for Auth background, about section, or lore highlights.

character_placeholder.description: Dark fantasy character portrait. Use as a placeholder for PCs and NPCs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fullstack hybrid React + FastAPI app.
Implement public read-only views: World Overview (Landing), Locations, Characters, Factions, Lore Timeline, and Bestiary.
Implement an Admin section (CMS) behind authentication for 2 DMs to manage the wiki content.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their default look to match the dark fantasy stone & lantern aesthetic.
For the hero section, use pure HTML/Tailwind with the hero_background image and a strong dark overlay.
Never use generic placeholder images; use the media URLs provided.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use lucide-react icons, focusing on fantasy-appropriate ones (Flame, Map, BookOpen, Castle, Swords, Ghost, etc.).
